id: title:jose-sequeira:wire the governor into the batcher in observe mode

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a governor and RTT observation to the ingestion batching state machine, potentially supporting a PostHog ingestion governor that throttles worker requests based on observed latency and worker availability.
review.reason: The observed changes introduce a `Governor` and its settings into the ingestion batcher state and snapshot, and add RTT observation. This could support a PostHog ingestion governor that throttles worker requests based on observed latency and worker availability, rather than relying solely on worker slot availability.
